column1: # Known gaps: run by the conformance test and counted, not enforced.
# Rows whose category has no ";" are not UniMorph's: the row yomitan-separated prefix is the row of tests/yomitan.tsv (Yomitan's test, GPL-3.0-or-later,
# Copyright (C) 2023-2026 Yomitan Authors, 2020-2022 Yomichan Authors) that only Yomitan's separated-prefix rule passes: it writes the verb and its particle
# as two words, which only a dictionary's multi-word rows read; this pack's rule needs the end of the clause and joins them (räum den Tisch auf. -> aufräumen,

# Source: UniMorph deu (https://github.com/unimorph/deu/blob/d226d2112d3490d8f04ece10d4538123d4297a39/deu, sha256 8bc98487e3caf861), CC BY-SA 3.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/), by the UniMorph contributors, from English Wiktionary.

# 1800 rows sampled with seed 1 by sources/build-corpus.mjs (50 adjective, superlative, 70 adjective, comparative, 180 adjective, declined, 100 noun, dative plural, 220 noun, plural, 120 noun, genitive, 30 noun, other singular, 150 verb, separated, 160 verb, participle, 60 verb, zu-infinitive, 80 verb, imperative, 160 verb, subjunctive, 200 verb, past, 220 verb, present); a separated particle's row ends with a full stop (rufe an.), a superlative's row is the adjective without am (schönsten). The rows the pack's rules reach are in corpus.tsv, the others in gaps.tsv.
